AVIATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #1
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: AVIATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Cargo Handling, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Cargo Handling.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Cargo Handling.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Cargo Handling.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Cargo Handling.

2. When learning Aircraft Related Drawing: Surface Development, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aircraft Related Drawing: Surface Development.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Aircraft Related Drawing: Surface Development.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Related Drawing: Surface Development.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aircraft Related Drawing: Surface Development.

3. When learning Introduction to Simulated Flying, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Simulated Flying.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Simulated Flying.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Simulated Flying.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Simulated Flying.

4. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Keyboard
   B. CPU
   C. Speaker
   D. Monitor

5. When learning Aircraft Systems, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aircraft Systems.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Aircraft Systems.

6. When learning Aircraft Stability, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   C. Skip safety briefings for Aircraft Stability.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Stability.

7. When learning Aviation Security, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aviation Security.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Aviation Security.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aviation Security.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aviation Security.

8. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   B. Run with the tool
   C. Remove all guards
   D. Work alone with eyes closed

9. When learning Career Opportunities in Aviation, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Career Opportunities in Aviation.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Career Opportunities in Aviation.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Career Opportunities in Aviation.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Career Opportunities in Aviation.

10. When learning Introduction to Unmanned Aircraft System, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Unmanned Aircraft System.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Unmanned Aircraft System.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Unmanned Aircraft System.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Unmanned Aircraft System.

11. When learning Flight Safety, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Flight Safety.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Flight Safety.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Flight Safety.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Flight Safety.

12. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. International Cricket Team
   B. Internal Cooking Timer
   C. Information and Communication Technology
   D. Input Cable Tester

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Aircraft Basic Maintenance and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Aircraft Related Drawing: Surface Development and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Aircraft Stability and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Simulated Flying and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
